LanguageData.IsekaiNoCameraJump_SettingsIntro: Choose which ISEKAI hunt events should keep their letters and targets without forcing the camera to jump. Changes apply immediately.
LanguageData.IsekaiNoCameraJump_SuppressIsekaiHunts: Block camera jumps for regular ISEKAI hunts
LanguageData.IsekaiNoCameraJump_SuppressIsekaiHuntsDe: Affects local hunt targets created by ISEKAI RPG LEVELING. Disable this to restore the original forced camera jump for these hunts.
LanguageData.IsekaiNoCameraJump_SuppressCreatureHunts: Block camera jumps for creature-pack hunts
Affects local hunt packs created by ISEKAI CREATURES ADD-ON. This option has no effect when that add-on is not installed.
